suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as treatment complication. Require gastroparesis treatment with a QT-/conduction-relevant prokinetic or antiemetic and a documented cardiac arrhythmia temporally related to that treatment. The source is pharmacotherapy/cardiac-safety focused; gastroparesis itself is not established as causing arrhythmia. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
